name: claude-code-auto-continue
description: Unofficial. Continues the Claude Code sessions you pick as soon as the usage limit resets — no more coming back hours later to type "continue".

claudeAutoContinue.enabled.description: Watch Claude Code sessions for usage limits and continue the chosen ones after the reset.

claudeAutoContinue.showUsage.markdownDescription: Show how much of the 5-hour and weekly Claude plan limits is used, as Claude Code last saw it (read from `~/.claude.json`, no network).

claudeAutoContinue.message.markdownDescription: Prompt sent after the reset. Empty = `continue` (or `продолжай` when VS Code is in Russian).

enumDescriptions: Ask for each session that hits the limit; nothing is sent until you say Continue.
Continue every session that hits the limit without asking.
Never continue automatically; only Send Now.
claudeAutoContinue.defaultChoice.description: What to do with a session that hits the limit before you choose.

claudeAutoContinue.delaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait after the reset time before sending.

claudeAutoContinue.keepAwake.description: Keep the computer from sleeping while a chosen session waits for its reset (the screen may still lock).

claudeAutoContinue.maxLateHours.description: Ignore sessions whose limit reset more than this many hours ago.
